title: JavaScript
match: Changed JavaScript logic, Promise/callback composition or module boundary.
exclude: a build tool happens to be written in JavaScript; Node.js/browser/framework behavior is a separate adapter.

title: TypeScript
match: Changed .ts/.tsx source or a public declaration/generic contract.
exclude: the repository only contains a TypeScript-based dependency; TypeScript alone does not imply React, browser or Node.

title: Python
match: Changed Python application, library, CLI or job source.
exclude: an unrelated script exists, or the host runs Python; .py does not imply Django, FastAPI, asyncio or free-threading.

title: Java
match: Actual Java source, class/module API or Java runtime behavior is changed.
exclude: a backend exists; Kotlin or another JVM language is not Java, and Java does not imply Spring.

title: C#
match: Changed C# logic or .NET-facing public types.
exclude: the feature is web, desktop or a game; those are independent domain choices.

title: C
match: Changed C translation units, headers or a C ABI boundary.
exclude: a C++ source or a native dependency exists without changes to C code.

title: C++
match: Changed C++ objects/templates, ownership, concurrency or binary interface.
exclude: a build tool uses C++; C and C++ are not interchangeable planning modes.

title: Go
match: Changed Go package, executable or concurrency contract.
exclude: Go is installed as tooling; a Go binary can be CLI, service or SDK.

title: Rust
match: Changed Rust crate, binary, trait/serde contract or FFI owner.
exclude: Cargo or a Rust-based utility is installed; Rust alone does not imply Tokio.

title: Swift
match: Changed Swift source, actor/task, value/reference or public module boundary.
exclude: the host is a Mac; server-side Swift is not a macOS UI project.

title: Kotlin
match: Changed Kotlin source, coroutine/Flow contract or Java interop.
exclude: a JVM service or Android dependency exists; Android and Spring are optional adapters.

title: PHP
match: Changed PHP request, command, package or long-lived worker source.
exclude: the application is a website; PHP does not imply Laravel or WordPress.

title: Ruby
match: Changed Ruby method/module, IO, extension boundary or package.
exclude: Rails is mentioned but not on the changed path; Ruby is also used for CLI and libraries.

title: Dart
match: Changed Dart library, async stream/future or isolate boundary.
exclude: Flutter is present in another package; Dart does not imply mobile or Flutter.

title: SQL
match: SQL queries, schema/constraint expressions or database-visible semantics are changed.
exclude: a database dependency exists, or an ORM reads unchanged fields.

title: Bash / POSIX shell
match: Changed shell scripts or shell command composition.
exclude: a command is executed somewhere; PowerShell and other shells have different languages.

title: PowerShell
match: Changed .ps1/.psm1 or PowerShell command/parameter logic.
exclude: the target is Windows; PowerShell may be cross-platform and Windows may use other languages.

title: R
match: Changed R analysis/package/statistical transformation.
exclude: a data task exists; R is a language, scientific/data work is a separate domain.

title: Lua
match: Changed Lua code or a Lua embedding boundary.
exclude: a game engine includes Lua internally; inspect version and host APIs (including LuaJIT/Luau differences).

title: HTML / CSS (markup and style languages)
match: Changed HTML semantics, form controls, styles or layout selectors.
exclude: a frontend exists without markup/style changes; this is not a JavaScript framework route.

title: React
match: Changed React components/hooks or React-owned state.
exclude: JS/TS code exists or a component library is installed.

title: Next.js
match: Changed Next.js routing, Server/Client Components, mutation or caching path.
exclude: a React app exists; inspect App/Pages Router and installed version.

title: Vue / Nuxt
match: Changed Vue components/reactivity or a confirmed Nuxt server/render path.
exclude: a JS/TS project exists; Nuxt-specific API behavior requires actual Nuxt evidence.

title: Angular
match: Changed Angular component, service, router or dependency lifetime.
exclude: TypeScript code exists without Angular owners.

title: Django
match: Changed Django view/model/ORM/transaction/migration code.
exclude: Python code or a database exists; framework activation needs imports/settings and the changed owner.

title: FastAPI
match: Changed FastAPI route/dependency/serialization or lifespan behavior.
exclude: Python, ASGI or Pydantic exists elsewhere; inspect actual route and dependency graph.

title: Spring
match: Changed Spring-managed controller/service/transaction/lifecycle path.
exclude: Java/Kotlin source exists; unknown JVM frameworks use universal fallback.

title: ASP.NET Core
match: Changed ASP.NET Core endpoint, middleware, DI service or background lifecycle.
exclude: C# source exists; .NET desktop/game/library code is not ASP.NET.

title: Ruby on Rails
match: Changed Rails route/model/callback/transaction or job path.
exclude: Ruby code exists; non-Rails code does not inherit callback conventions.

title: Laravel
match: Changed Laravel controller/Eloquent/job/lifecycle code.
exclude: PHP source exists without Laravel owners.

title: Flutter
match: Changed Flutter widgets, navigation, model binding or plugin boundary.
exclude: Dart code exists or a mobile target is mentioned.

title: SwiftUI / AppKit
match: Changed SwiftUI views/model binding or AppKit delegate/bridge behavior.
exclude: Swift is used on a server or macOS hosts an unrelated service.

title: Node.js
match: Changed Node runtime-specific stream, process, file, worker or module behavior.
exclude: JavaScript/TypeScript runs in a browser or another host.

title: Tokio
match: Changed Tokio select/task/channel/process path in real Rust source.
exclude: Rust or async syntax exists without Tokio.

title: macOS
match: Changed macOS app/window/helper/XPC/device or packaged launch behavior.
exclude: development happens on a Mac; Python/Rust service hosting alone is insufficient.

title: iOS / iPadOS
match: Changed Apple mobile scenes, app lifecycle, permission, storage or delivery path.
exclude: Swift/Dart/JS is present; confirm the actual Apple target.

title: Android
match: Changed Android lifecycle/component, permission, data or packaged behavior.
exclude: Java/Kotlin/Dart source exists; the language does not prove Android.

title: Browser web platform
match: Changed browser DOM/events/fetch/history/storage/worker semantics.
exclude: a web-related repository exists but the touched path is server-only.

title: Svelte / SvelteKit
match: Changed Svelte components or SvelteKit action/load/endpoint/consumer code.
exclude: Svelte is merely an unused dependency.

title: Web frontend / interaction
match: A requested change concerns browser-visible interaction, navigation, rendering or client state.
exclude: the repository has a frontend that this task does not change.

title: Backend services / APIs
match: The task changes a service handler, business operation, job consumer or exposed API.
exclude: the project is full-stack but only a UI style changes.

title: Desktop applications
match: A requested feature changes window/document/editor/device/helper workflows in a desktop application.
exclude: the developer is on a desktop machine; CLI services are separate domains.

title: Mobile applications
match: The change targets a mobile user workflow or its platform lifecycle/data behavior.
exclude: Kotlin, Swift, Dart or a mobile SDK appears in unrelated code.

title: CLI / automation / developer tooling
match: A requested outcome is a command, build/developer utility, batch script or terminal automation.
exclude: a command is used merely to build a different product.

title: Libraries / SDKs / reusable packages
match: A public reusable library/API/package is the deliverable or changes observably.
exclude: a project uses dependencies but only application internals change.

title: Systems software / daemons / local IPC
match: The feature changes a long-lived service, IPC/protocol handler, process lifecycle or resource owner.
exclude: Rust/C++ is present or an app launches unchanged tooling.

title: Cloud / platform / DevOps
match: Deployment/configuration/IaC/CI/service-operability behavior is the requested change.
exclude: an app is deployed in cloud but only local business logic changes.

title: Data engineering / pipelines / analytics delivery
match: The change ingests/transforms/materializes datasets or alters delivery to analytical/operational consumers.
exclude: Python/SQL exists or a page reads unchanged database fields.

title: AI / ML / model-enabled features
match: The product change concerns training/evaluation/inference, retrieval, model outputs or agent/tool behavior.
exclude: the coding assistant uses an LLM; every coded task is not an AI domain task.

title: Scientific / numerical / simulation software
match: The change computes a scientific/numerical result or modifies a simulation/analysis contract.
exclude: Python/R/C++ exists; the domain follows the task outcome.

title: Embedded / IoT / device control
match: The feature changes firmware, hardware interaction, sensor/control pipeline or constrained-device state.
exclude: C/Rust exists without a device boundary; do not infer hardware from language.

title: Games / real-time interactive media
match: The feature changes gameplay, simulation/render timing, entity lifecycle or interactive media behavior.
exclude: C#/C++/Lua exists; engine and language are separate.

title: Full-stack application delivery
match: One requested outcome crosses UI/client, service/data and direct readers.
exclude: Only local frontend or backend behavior changes in a larger repository.
